title: Home node registry and durable pairings v1
description: The Home's durable record of the nodes that paired with it and of the pairings it minted (docs/modules/remote_execution.md, 'Node registry, confirmation and trust'; design docs/MULTI_DEVICE_NETWORK_DESIGN.md sections 5, 7, 10). Records live in the Home's selected storage authority through portable record CAS, so they survive a Home restart and are shared by the API host and the execution host. Liveness is never stored: online/last_seen come from the bridge's poll observation. A node record is keyed '<owner>:<nodeId>'; a credential index record '<owner>:<credentialId>' names the node a credential was issued to and is a hint validated against the node record. A pairing record is keyed '<owner>:<pairingId>' and is reached during redemption through two digest index records ('code:<sha256>' and 'link:<sha256>'), so neither the 6-digit code nor the link secret is stored in clear. Owner: lib/desktop/node_registry.py and lib/desktop/pairing.py.

x-confirmation.description: Owner decision 5 (2026-11-17, on): redeeming a pairing creates a pending node. A pending node's polls are admitted to the transport but it is never registered with the bridge, so no command can be addressed to it; its poll answer carries node.state='pending_confirmation' and is held until the owner confirms or the bridge long-poll window ends. Confirming makes it active; rejecting revokes the credential issued at redemption. A pairing for a node ID that is already active under another credential is a pending replacement: the active credential keeps working until the owner confirms (old credential revoked) or rejects (new credential revoked).
x-confirmation.legacy_adoption: A bridge credential without a node record that was not issued by pairing (credential metadata origin != 'desktop_pairing': credentials minted before this registry existed, or by the owner's authenticated POST /api/v1/desktop/token) is adopted as an active node bound to the first node ID that polls with it. A pairing-issued credential without its node record is refused (desktop_node_unregistered).

x-identity.fingerprint: Upper-case hex of sha256('tofu-node-fingerprint/v1\0' + nodeId + '\0' + credentialId), first 8 digits, formatted XXXX-XXXX. The node computes it from its own ID and the PairResponse id, the Home from its record; the owner compares both before confirming.
x-identity.binding: A credential is bound to exactly one node ID. A poll whose agent_id differs from the node its credential was issued to is refused with 409 desktop_node_identity_conflict and the node record records the conflict; the polling process stops that link instead of retrying.
x-identity.boot: Every node process sends a fresh boot_id in its poll frame. When a node ID's earlier boot polls again after a newer boot of the same ID was observed (two live processes with one identity), the earlier boot is refused with 409 desktop_node_identity_conflict; a restart (old boot silent) is never a conflict. Boot observation is transport state of the poll-terminating process, not stored.

reason.description: credential_reused: another node ID presented this node's credential; node_id_taken: another credential presented this node ID; duplicate_boot: two live processes of this node ID.

predecessorCredentialId.description: Private binding used to refuse retirement of a different incarnation of the predecessor.

predecessor.description: The node this pending node says it replaces on the same host (renamed host, recreated container: PairRequest.previous_node_id), when the owner has such a node. Confirming forgets the predecessor unless it is online at that moment (then the two are twins and both stay); either way the field clears.

nodeTransition.description: Answer of confirm / reject / rename / remove.

devicesChanged.description: Owner-scoped push hint published on every registry change (pair, confirm, reject, rename, remove, conflict). The UI re-reads GET /api/v4/desktop/nodes; the hint carries no state.
